reports.title: SolarEdge Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Outlook for the Fourth Quarter of 2026
section: The Company provides the following guidance for the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026. This guidance excludes potential IEEPA refunds in the fourth quarter.

Guidance Metric | Q4 2026 Guidance
Revenue | $245 million – $275 million
Non-GAAP gross margin* | 17% – 21%
Non-GAAP operating expenses* | $87 million – $91 million
